# `wholesale_invoice`

Area: **wholesale** ([all tables](README.md))

A wholesale invoice of the network partner (not a TMF678 customer bill), imported by an operator and reconciled against the lines and usage the BSS knows. Immutable once reconciled; a corrected invoice is a new import under another number.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `invoice_number` | `text` | no |  |  |
| `period` | `daterange` | no |  | From the earliest line start to the latest line end (half-open). |
| `currency` | `character(3)` | no |  |  |
| `total` | `numeric(14,2)` | no |  | The sum of its line amounts. |
| `line_count` | `integer` | no |  |  |
| `state` | `text` | no |  | imported (lines stored), reconciled (discrepancies found); the import does both in one transaction. |
| `imported_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  |  |
| `imported_by` | `text` | no |  | The operator who imported it. |
